title: Inspect expression types
description: You use :t to inspect the type of an expression in GHCi.

steps.description: The Num constraint says that 42 can have a type that supports numeric operations.
The type [Char] means a list of characters. Haskell uses it for strings.
The addition operator takes two values of the same numeric type and returns that type.
True has type Bool, the type for Boolean values.
